name: Blockstamp
all_locations: Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
long_description: Blockstamp is an asset management software for industrial equipment. We provide in-depth analytics and fleet management dashboards for industrial equipments (forklifts, cranes, hoists, etc.). We help large manufacturing companies manage their fleets of industrial equipment to allow them to make business decisions.
one_liner: Blockstamp is an asset management software for industrial equipment

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Focused on helping manufacturing companies improve their industrial equipment.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Hello! I am a co-founder of Nomad rides from the S19 batch. We grew a rideshare service in the hay day of Uber and Lyft to 6 different cities, most of them being campus/college towns. We operated at high level of scale at two of those campuses. It was an incredible journey, not to mention a lot of fun. Please reach out if it would be beneficial for us to connect!
